Mjlab-Flip-Switch-Franka.notes: Motion profile: BALLISTIC COMMIT past a detent. A spring pushes the toggle back until it crosses centre, so quasi-static servoing fails and success is a state flip, not a displacement threshold (contrast Push-Button, a compliant press). Structural (smoke) gate only; reward shaping not yet train-validated.

Mjlab-Lift-Cube-Franka.notes: Grasp-and-lift; the canonical fragile task in FINDINGS.md (catastrophic forgetting under regularization-only CL).

Mjlab-Lift-Cube-Franka-Leap.notes: Franka arm + LEAP hand grasping and lifting a cube (dexterous grasp on a full arm).

Mjlab-Lift-Cube-Leap.notes: Floating LEAP hand grasping and lifting a cube with its fingers (dexterous grasp). Reuses the arm lift base with the hand embodiment.

Mjlab-Lift-Cylinder-Franka.notes: Grasp-and-lift a cylinder; rolls and lacks flat faces, so grasp alignment is less forgiving than the cube (grasp-geometry generalization).

Mjlab-Lift-Ellipsoid-Franka.notes: Grasp-and-lift an elongated ellipsoid; grasp success depends on approach orientation (grasp across the short axis).

Mjlab-Lift-Sphere-Franka.notes: Grasp-and-lift a sphere; rolls, no flat faces — hardest free-object grasp geometry (grasp-geometry generalization).

Mjlab-Lift-Sphere-Leap.notes: Floating LEAP hand grasping and lifting a sphere (hardest grasp geometry).

Mjlab-Open-Lid-Franka.notes: Motion profile: VERTICAL ARC UNDER GRAVITY. Gravity opposes the motion throughout and the lid falls shut if released, unlike the door's gravity-neutral vertical-axis swing. NOTE: runs with gravity ENABLED, unlike the other articulation tasks. Structural (smoke) gate only; reward shaping not yet train-validated.

Mjlab-Peg-Insertion-Franka.notes: Insert a peg into a hole board: grasp + tight alignment into a ~3cm hole. Reuses the Stack MDP with tighter xy tolerance. New 'insertion' skill; most fragile tier (multi-contact precision).

Mjlab-Peg-Insertion-Leap.notes: Floating LEAP hand inserting a peg into a hole board.

Mjlab-Place-In-Container-Franka.notes: Success shape: CONTAINMENT + RELEASE (inside the footprint, below the rim, settled) rather than the stable-contact predicate used by Stack. The bin walls also make the approach non-monotonic — a straight-line reach to the goal hits a wall. Structural (smoke) gate only; reward shaping not yet train-validated.

Mjlab-Push-Button-Franka.notes: Press a button; forgiving, retained near-1.0 through sequences.

Mjlab-Reach-Target-Franka.notes: Move the gripper to a sampled 3D target; dense monotonic reward, no contact. Anchors the low-fragility end of the axis (new 'reach' skill family).

Mjlab-Reach-Target-Franka-Leap.notes: Franka arm + LEAP hand reaching to a 3D target. First Class-B (arm + dexterous hand) task; reuses the arm reach base.

Mjlab-Reach-Target-Leap.notes: Floating LEAP hand reaching its palm to a 3D target (actuated 6-DoF base). First Class-C task; reuses the arm reach base with the hand embodiment.

Mjlab-Reorient-Object-Franka.notes: Success shape: ORIENTATION, not position — the only Class A task scored on angular alignment (stand a lying cylinder upright). Position enters only as a loose anti-fling drift bound. Structural (smoke) gate only; reward shaping not yet train-validated.

Mjlab-Rotate-Valve-Franka.notes: Motion profile: MULTI-CYCLE ROTATION WITH REGRASP. The 270deg target exceeds the wrist range from any single grasp, so the policy must turn, release, re-grasp the opposite spoke and continue — the only Class A task needing a regrasp cycle. Structural (smoke) gate only; reward shaping not yet train-validated.

Mjlab-Slide-Window-Franka.notes: Motion profile: LATERAL FACE-PUSH. Same joint type as Open-Drawer but along the robot's lateral axis, and the drawer's proven fingertip-hook strategy does not transfer (you push a face, not hook a bar). Structural (smoke) gate only; reward shaping not yet train-validated.

Mjlab-Stack-Cube-Franka.notes: Stack a cube on a cuboid base: grasp + precise place + release. Dynamic goal (tracks the base object). Higher-fragility pick_place than lift.

Mjlab-Stack-Cube-Franka-Leap.notes: Franka arm + LEAP hand stacking a cube on a cuboid base.

Mjlab-Stack-Cube-Leap.notes: Floating LEAP hand stacking a cube on a cuboid base.

Mjlab-Tool-Pull-Franka.notes: Motion profile: TWO-STAGE TOOL USE — grasp a stick, then drag a puck that spawns beyond direct reach back into the near zone. Contact that matters happens at the tool tip, not the fingertips. First TOOL_USE task in the benchmark. Structural (smoke) gate only; reward shaping not yet train-validated.

Mjlab-Turn-Lever-Franka.notes: Motion profile: WRIST ROTATION about the approach axis. The lever hinge points at the robot, so turning it rotates the wrist rather than pulling with the arm (contrast Open-Door, a whole-arm hinge arc). Structural (smoke) gate only; reward shaping not yet train-validated.
